newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares surge nearly two pct at start.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares surge nearly two pct at start.

text.p: Dutch shares surged 14.10 points or nearly two percent to 762.79 at the opening on Wednesday, buoyed by Wall Street's second biggest point gain in its history and Philips results that came in above expectations.

Wall Street surged 2.6 percent on what analysts linked to heavy fund buying. Philips earlier on Wednesday posted first quarter net profits at 887 million guilders, up from 692 million in the same period a year ago.
The AEX index closed on Tuesday up 3.77 points at 748.69.
